notes.title: We’ve Gone To Plaid!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/e0dd66cf145752a153ffd17c7a6ea0c97b587860.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p align="start"]Make sure your tank’s full up on Coaxium (or Dilithium crystals - we don’t pick sides!) because it’s time for the return of the Outer Space Event! [/p][p align="start"]Step aboard the bridge of the SPS Uncrushable, where you’ll have to do more than just press fake buttons in the background if you want to prove yourself to this crew of smart, seductive sci-fi babes! Your assignment? To complete all mission objectives before September 29th.[/p][p align="start"]Those who do will be handsomely rewarded, and we’re not talking about some chintzy space medallion hung around your neck by a wisecracking princess, either! No, we’re talking about wisecracking alien bounty hunter Loola, retiring from her dangerous life on the galaxy’s outer rim to settle with you in your main game, instead! [/p][p align="start"]So suit up, Ensigns, set phasers to stunning, and remember…[/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Fly (You) to the Moon
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/dc6943816016c97a1d782877191fb2fd49cb6c49.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p align="start"]Ready to go where no marshmallow has gone before? Or maybe you HAVE gone there before, but you’d like to go back and have another chance at scoring sultry outer space bounty hunter Loola for your game?[/p][p align="start"]Well then, we have good news for you! The Outer Space Event is returning soon, so mark your calendars for stardate September 25 and be prepared to be transported![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: The Return of the Mega Sale
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/b9f41c14c8d928e23e6549794a33ffc2ad07ce64.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p align="start"]We're having another one of our epic mega sales, so prepare your eyeballs, because they’re about to read a long list of details![/p][p align="start"]Did you do it? Did you prepare your eyeballs?[/p][p align="start"]Okay! First up, Diamond Bundles are 10% off! If you've been meaning to stock up on some shiny pink rocks, now would be a great time. Next, DLC Girl Bundles are also 10% off! That includes Ranma, Brie, Mallory, Suzu, Explora, Charlotte, Catara, Darya, Lotus, AND for the first time ever, all three [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3630990/Crush_Crush__Kaiju_Bundle/"]Kaiju Girls[/url]! Phone Fling Girl Bundles are 10% off, too, and finally, we're bringing ALL of the Limited Time Event girls back to the Store at a 10% discount. There are way too many names to name in that category, of course, so your best bet is to just hop on over to the in-game Store and check out the list for yourself.[/p][p align="start"]Hopefully your eyeballs aren't too tired from reading all that, because there's one more piece of important info: this sale runs from September 18th to the 24th![/p][p align="start"]Now that you're equipped with everything you need to know, you can give your eyeballs a rest. And wake up your fingers, because they're gonna have to get clicking![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Breaking News
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/09fdf01c9fc898ffe9a3d98305a3f57f6b68aae9.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p align="start"]Word in the newsroom is that you no longer need to tune in for Channel 69’s weather forecast just to get a glimpse of your favorite flirtatious weathergirl! If you’re ready to meet (and date) the one-and-only Sofia, all you have to do is complete her Limited Time Event and make sure you’ve finished her latest Phone Fling. Also, you might want to stock up on sunscreen, umbrellas, and other weather-related paraphernalia, because Sofia’s definitely going to want to live life to the absolute fullest with you - rain or shine![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Forecasting Fun
notes.notes: [p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/912413e9e52dc0d61af0d648181bbff207039689.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p align="start"]Do you hear your (in-game) cell phone going “ding-a-ling”? It’s probably trying to let you know that you’ve received a new message from Sofia! Better go check it out and see what she has to say. After all, the Limited Time Event to unlock her starts in a few days! And it’s always good to be prepared - for the weather, yes, but also for meeting new girls![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: No Time Like The Present
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/1ff611ccc2d5f74d0b7ebf8a02322e04fa3d44c5.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p align="start"]The time for clock watching is over. The time to play the brand new Time Warp Event is now![/p][p align="start"]Polly, our intrepid time traveler, is soaring across the space-time continuum in her time machine as we speak. All you have to do is jump through that familiar parallel event portal and hitch a ride with her! Surely nothing can go wrong, right?[/p][p align="start"]This event features a special reset mechanic to help you boost your progress and fling you through the ages, so it’s sure to be an extra-special experience. Plus, Polly will be by your side the whole time to help guide you! Of course, you’ll still have to complete all your event goals before the timer runs out in order to bring Polly back to your Main Game. That means working various era-specific jobs, wooing hotties throughout history, etcetera, etcetera…[/p][p align="start"]The Time Warp Event runs from September 11-17, which means there’s no time to waste! Get your head out of the hourglass and play now![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: ATTENTION!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/bdfa4bfa9aefa483c8d88a962015939116fac26c.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p align="start"]You have a new tactical assignment: log in every day, collect all your event tokens, and unlock Ranma’s brand new animated pinup![/p][p align="start"]You heard us right! The military-tough (and fully animated) red panda girl now has her own fully animated pinup, and it can be yours if you manage to make your way through the boot camp that is the Limited Time Event. Alternatively, you can always unlock this artwork immediately with some Diamonds! Either way, this is a VERY important mission, so don’t just sit there! Ranma’s waiting for you to join her in gym. Get moving![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: It’s almost TIME!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/c71a46e7bb1ecc100fc40e5cb408b416c76c865a.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p align="start"]We’re here to announce the launch of a brand new Parallel Event, and this one’s SPECIAL! The theme is time travel, which means you’ll be moving through the ages using a reset mechanic that’s totally unique to this event. At the same time, you’ll be doing era-specific jobs and trying out various historical hobbies as you work to check off all your goals![/p][p align="start"]And your grand prize? The lady who’s going to guide you through the pleasures and pitfalls of time travel? We’ll keep her identity on the down-low for now, but trust us… she’s thematically appropriate and very cool.[/p][p align="start"]The brand new Time Warp Event starts September 11th, so mark your calendars, wind your watches, flip your hourglasses, and let the countdown begin![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: FALL in Love
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/03e4f5964b0dcc0421302471f1d144e8a6edfa60.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p align="start"]There’s just something about fall… that crisp, cool way the air smells, the changing of the leaves, the promise of a bountiful harvest… It’s a nature-lover’s delight, don’t you think? So what better time to hold a Flash Sale featuring none other than gentle spirit of the wilderness, Suzu? For 24 hours only, she’s 50% off in the Store, but if you already have her in your roster, don’t despair! We’re also offering 15% off Diamond Bundles as well, to spend as you see fit![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Super Efficient Pandas
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/a8c4834d75492034e32158f71f645726dc94f003.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p align="start"]We’re popping in just to say “Hey! There’s a flash sale happening!”[/p][p align="start"]And also to give you the important details, such as “Diamond Bundles are 15% off in the Store” and “You can get the Lotus Bundle for 50% off!” and “This sale lasts for 24 hours only!”[/p][p](Sidenote: Lotus can be unlocked for FREE if you own [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/782250/Hush_Hush__Only_Your_Love_Can_Save_Them"]Hush Hush[/url])[/p][p align="start"]And now that we’ve said those things, we’ll be on our way![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Too Cool for Back To School
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/670aca828493526131bd0fa0131ce6679fb26c82.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p align="start"]Do you hear that? It’s the sound of the school bell ringing! YOU’RE LATE FOR CLASS!!![/p][p align="start"]Actually… maybe that’s a good thing? This new girl seems the type to appreciate a bit of delinquent behavior. Her name’s Kyoko, and she’s the hot loner/misunderstood bad girl on campus! Wanna meet up and try to impress her? All you have to do is hop through the in-game parallel event portal and make your way through the School Spirit Event.[/p][p align="start"]What are you still reading this for? You’ve got homework to complete, tests to study for, and extracurricular activities to participate in! At the very least, you have event goals to check off. Complete them all and Kyoko will unlock in your main game as a fully dateable character![/p][p align="start"]Remember, you have from August 27 - September 2 to get it done. No extensions![/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard,[/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Back to School? Already?
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/7d8979ec9dea38487a79d1f2e341a3be8b63da9d.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p align="start"]It’s officially back-to-school season, and the upcoming semester is going to knock your socks off! Of course, when we say “semester” we really mean “parallel event.” It’s much shorter than a semester, and probably more fun, because there are a LOT of cute girls to chat and flirt with, and no homework to get in the way![/p][p align="start"]Anyway… We’re here to let you know that the School Spirit Event is coming back from August 27 - September 2, and this time there’s a brand new reward girl waiting to meet you! You, uh, might want to grow a spine, though, because she is one tough cookie. In a good way! As long as you check off all your event-related goals, she’ll probably be impressed. Or at least amused.[/p][p align="start"]We love you so hard![/p][p align="start"]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: And the winner is… SOFIA!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/ebac918b6fc71632e6dcb816aa5e1a7c16f53f0a.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]Let the rain pour! Let the snow fall! Let the wind blow! The charming, flirtatious weather forecaster Sofia is the winner of the girl vs. girl voting event, which means she’s about to get a total makeover! Not that she needs one. I mean, have you SEEN those eyes? That hair? Those curves!? Sofia is one of the most gorgeous women ever![/p][p]We’ll get straight to work transforming Sofia from “phone fling” to “true love”. All you have to do is sit tight! Maybe practice your small talk while you’re waiting? After all, Sofia LOVES talking about the weather.[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who voted! We’ll let you know when Sofia is ready to meet you![/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Ring Ring, Save Some Bling Bling!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/110e1d92233d4ac8f89bc941eaedabc5ec96405a.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]Did you vote in the latest Vote-A-Fling, and now you’re unsure about whether or not you can bear to wait for the winner’s official debut in game? How about some cute-as-heck company to help you pass the time? From August 14th to the 19th, hit up the Store and save 20% on our other fabulous Phone Fling girls: Willow, Honey, Miss Desirée, Amelia, Babybelle, Nova, Lake, Renée, Sawyer, Ruri, Generica, and Wendy! [/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: The Returning Return of Rosa
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/87e891e56c1dd5c6c5a6aa39cdf0504d13eccb24.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p]The melodrama continues! Or repeats itself, rather, for those who missed its previous runs. Our beautiful Rosa is back for another Limited Time Event, and her story is as passionate and theatrical as ever. But just like with your favorite telenovelas, you’ll have to tune in every day if you hope to claim her heart! (That’s our fancy way of telling you to collect all the daily tokens to unlock Rosa as a dateable character).[/p][p]So go - sprint through the pouring rain if you have to! Don’t leave her \[Crying in Spanish]![/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Vote now! Girl vs. Girl!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/65e8f155c45f4d15fbf86daf0c6ad3a5e46a249b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p]We're here to let you know that for the first time ever, two Phone Fling girls are going head-to-head in a versus battle! Well, it's less of a "battle" and more of a "let's see which girl can tip the scales in her favor." The real question is this: who do YOU want to see turned into a fully dateable character?[/p][p]You get one free vote to cast for either Sofia, our beautiful weathergirl, or Caitlin, our flirtatious gymnast-turned-model. If you're feeling especially passionate, you also have the option of purchasing up to 9 more votes using Diamonds! Oh, and the process of voting is simple - just open up your game and you'll see a pop-up. With buttons and stuff! It's very cute (if we do say so ourselves).[/p][p]The voting period runs from August 11th to 15th. At the end, the girl with the most votes will be crowned the winner, and we'll begin the process of transforming her from Phone Fling to Full Girl right away! We can’t WAIT to see who wins![/p][p]Love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Summer Lovin’ Happened So Fast…
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/1148903cde9d8257b468a2324928d51a0b1a9f9e.png"][/img]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]Hey, um, quick question… How the HECK is it August already? We know time flies when you’re having fun, but could it maybe… not do that? Do we have any of our top scientists looking into a way to make time fly when you’re having a CRAPPY time? Like when you’re at the dentist or something? [/p][p]Anyway… Speaking of time flying, did we mention that we’re doing a Flash Sale? For 24 hours only, take 15% off all Diamond Bundle purchases in the Store, and in honor of the all-too-short summer strawberry season, how about 50% off sweet Mallory, as well? [/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: A Smol Mochi Appears!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/72f712b0725a5e96a78dc732165261822aaf5abd.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p]Do you love fox girls who are dainty, delicate, and syrupy-sweet? Fox girls who love you more than anything in the whole wide world and would do anything just to make your life a little easier? Fox girls with a number of… other impressive qualities?[/p][p]If the answer is yes, then we have the pinup for you! This is a brand new, fully-animated pinup of our resident kitsune girl Suzu, and it's available for you to unlock in the Limited Time Event. Just log on daily and collect your tokens to have this sentimental piece of artwork added to your Memory Album! Of course, if you need it in your life RIGHT NOW, you can always toss some Diamonds at it! Aaaand now we're imagining Suzu bending down to pick up Diamonds… Nice.[/p][p]We love you so hard![/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Chill!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/b342419a11601375e7c59302e16283efd7fe17d8.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]We warned you, and now it’s happening. The Frosty Event has returned![/p][p]The parallel event portal will be open from July 31st to August 5th, which means now’s your opportunity to unlock a whole whack of wintery rewards - including the beautiful and elegant dancer Grace! So get in there and start wooing those holiday cuties and checking off your event goals.[/p][p]If you need us, we’ll be rocking around the Frostmas tree![/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]~The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Beat the heat!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/a58977077da2791c7ecb956314498cb00330fcfb.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]Is it sweltering hot where you are? Pretty soon you’ll be able to beat the heat with the returning Frosty Event! Do you live somewhere where it doesn’t happen to be summertime right now? That’s okay, the returning Frosty Event is for you, too![/p][p]The returning reward character this time around is our sweet ballerina Grace, so mark your calendars for July 31st to August 5th if you want to participate and unlock her! We have it on good authority that she can’t wait to dance around the Frostmas tree with you <3[/p][p]We love you so hard![/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: It’s a Summer Sale! Unless it’s winter where you’re at…
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/5f1f4499949fe9a10b52119a1681f6deaa9d7207.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps, [/p][p]Do you long to see your waifus wearing itsy bitsy, teenie weenie bikinis… with or without yellow polkadots? Then boy howdy do we have a sale for you! From July 24th to the 29th, stop by the Store and get [b]50% off[/b] the Bikini Outfit Bundle so all your best gfs can hit the beach in style![/p][p]Not swimsuit season on your side of the planet? (Yeah, that’s right, we saw your comments calling us out for assuming everyone’s in the Northern Hemisphere!) No problem! Peeps the world over can also get [b]25% Bonus Diamonds[/b] with every Diamond Bundle purchase! [/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Sale, Front and Center!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/089823019261e47b7f55e04a0f298148d0a9a47c.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]Set your watches with military precision, because for the next 24 hours exactly, Ranma is 50% off! In addition to the most beautiful babe in all the red panda army, Diamonds are a cool 15% off! Keep an eye on that clock and don’t let time get away from you or these deals slip through your fingers! You wouldn’t want to find out how Ranma deals with panda recruits who miss their deadlines…[/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Alright! Okay! Some good news comes your way!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/112b62d5c40afe9bb1fe25ac90c8171e7e40d839.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p][/p][p]One, two, three, four, what are you cheering for? We hope it's Karyn's return in the School Spirit Event, because the Parallel Event Portal is now open and accepting applications! [/p][p][/p][p]You definitely don’t want to miss out on dating this adorable cheer captain, but remember, you only have a limited time to unlock her! The event runs from July 10 to 16, and you’ve got to attend all your classes and complete all your homework assignments (i.e. check off all your event goals) if you want to bring Karyn back to your Main Game as a fully dateable girl.[/p][p][/p][p]STF University may have a reputation for its high academic standards, but with the ever-positive and bubbly Karyn by your side, even the most daunting all-nighter cram-fest will seem like a treat![/p][p][/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: A Twist of Fate
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/b2a8fc9f03c47ba85803f861532ab6a6e3eb31d9.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p]Our favorite enigmatic seer, Esper, is making her return to the Limited Time Event! We know you’ve been waiting for her insightful touch, so we bet you’re just as excited as we are! Esper has always had a knack for perception, unveiling secrets and possibilities with just a glance at her trusty crystal ball. But even the strongest psychic couldn’t predict the smashing first impression you make on her! [/p][p]Will this spark an unexpected adventure or an enlightening connection? Unlocking Esper is the only way to answer that question, so log in every day during the Limited Time Event and collect your daily tokens before time runs out.[/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: The Kaiju Bundle
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/abd53eec0ed4c8a630acf6e0b32df1e0eaed9cc7.png"][/img]Hey Panda Peeps,  [/p][p]We’ve teased. We’ve foreshadowed. We’ve made you wait long enough. [/p][p]It’s time for us to release… The Kaiju Bundle!  [/p][p]This is a big deal. A big, BIG deal! Let us introduce you to moth-girl Mortha, Sephia of the deep blue sea, and Liz - queen of the monsters! These three gals are rival kaiju who just can’t help but cause mayhem and destruction wherever they go.  [/p][p]That’s where you come in! After all, you’re a hero-type person! Who better to save the city (and woo some overpowered, otherworldly babes while doing it) than you?[/p][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3630990/Crush_Crush__Kaiju_Bundle" style="button"]The Kaiju Bundle [/url] includes all three kaiju girls and features a unique, interconnected storyline with a few special features you’re sure to love. The girls are fully-voiced and come with an array of gorgeous outfits available at Lover level! You can purchase the bundle through the in-game Store OR directly from the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3630990/Crush_Crush__Kaiju_Bundle"]Steam store page[/url] for $15 USD. [/p][p]No time limit here - this bundle will be available permanently, so you can add it to your wishlist without fear of missing out!  [/p][p]We can’t wait for you to finally meet Mortha, Sephia, and Liz! Who do you think is going to be your favorite?  [/p][p]We love you so hard!  [/p][p]~The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Participation Trophies for Everyone
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/1eca43f4d8a7328bac1a7e892fc7f94149e8fab4.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]Can you smell that? It’s kind of giving off… stress, exams, extracurricular activities, and popularity contests. Ah, we’ve got it! It smells like school spirit![/p][p]Mark your calendars, because from July 10 to 16, things are going to get scholarly. The School Spirit Event is due to return, and the ever-positive, super-bubbly cheerleader Karyn is rooting for your success![/p][p]Roll up your sleeves and prepare to do educational hobbies and highlight your skills with school-related jobs to unlock a myriad of rewards. If you manage a 4.0, Karyn will join you in your main game as a fully-dateable girl. How’s that for academic incentive?[/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: A Sale Faster Than Her Load Time
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/369e33a9cf5c74a54841ea312eada4e96ca70402.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Panda Peeps,[/p][p]For the next 24 hours only, all Diamond Bundles are 15% off!  If it’s not premium currency, but nostalgia you’re after, Explora is 50% off too!  But not to worry.  Unlike her interface, her download speed is up-to-date, and once you buy her, she’s ready to play immediately![/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Did you feel that?
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/1948898148d5dff66d9f82a508d5809aad385708.png"][/img]Hey Panda Peeps!  [/p][p]Did you happen to notice the water in your glass start trembling just now? Can you feel the floor beneath your feet vibrating rhythmically? Do you hear the sound of massive footsteps in the distance, coming closer?  [/p][p]Pretty weird, huh?  [/p][p]Anyway! Here’s a link to the[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3630990/Crush_Crush__Kaiju_Bundle"] [/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3630990/Crush_Crush__Kaiju_Bundle" style="button" buttoncolor="#095dbe"]Kaiju DLC Store Page[/url]. If you check it out, you’ll find a brand new character bundle there called the Kaiju Bundle! That explains a lot.  [/p][p]It’s marked “Coming Soon”, so you'd better add it to your wishlist. Also, tell all your friends. And all your enemies. Whatever it takes to spread the word!  [/p][p]We love you so hard!  [/p][p]~The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: A Girl and Her Cheese
notes.notes:

Hey Panda Peeps![/p][p]The girl whom this poem’s about[/p][p]Was a Rodentian local and scout[/p][p]Who flew to the moon[/p][p]At a quarter to noon[/p][p]And finding no cheese, she did pout[/p][p]Now, obviously, the best way to cheer her up would be to give her more cheese than she ever thought possible, and that’s exactly what’s happening in Brie’s brand new animated pinup, now available in the Limited Time Event! Log in every day during the event and collect your daily tokens to unlock this brand new work of art for your memory album.[/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

As always, this Parallel Event will feature a variety of romantic tasks, sentimental goals, and syrupy-sweet rewards, including the chance to summon the delicious demoness, Desdemona![/p][p]The Valentine’s Event starts on June 19 and runs until June 23. It all starts in a few days, so mark your calendars and set your internal clocks for maximum play time![/p][p]We love you so hard,[/p][p]The Pandas[/p]

notes.title: Sale Jitters
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/f8e51fb43c876c76d463214d817650a141dc4116.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

Bigger than the tallest mountain in the world! Bigger than the amount of weird and creepy fish in the sea! Bigger than our love for you! It’s the JUNE MEGA SALE!

Running from June 4 to 10, this is your chance to grab anything and everything you may have had your eye on… all at a discount! Diamond purchases are 10% off for those of you who like shiny things. DLC girls are 10% off for those of you with missing spots on your roster. Phone Fling characters are 10% off for those of you who need to meet your latest romance face-to-face.

But what might be the best offer is that Limited Time Event girls, INCLUDING Willow, are 10% off, and we’ve brought them all back! You read that right: every Limited Time Event girl is available and on sale, so jump on this opportunity to flirt, fantasize, and fall in love before it passes you by.

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Tessa’s Back For Snuggles!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/0e62d39dc64f27c83d52b1a802e3027d9a4a57b2.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

If you need a ray of sunshine, we’ve got great news! With her playful spirit and adorable floppy ears, Tessa is back in the Limited Time Event and all set to become your go-to best friend. She’s the perfect person to add that cheerful pup vibe to your game, so jump at this opportunity to unleash all that love!

All you have to do is log in every day during the event and collect your daily tokens to bring her into your life. Trust us, you won’t want to miss out on this bundle of joy! Because let’s be honest, who doesn’t want a whirlwind of love to greet you with pure happiness every time?

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: The Mummy Returns… Again!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/febc432299f279c3f78cd0d67e26466cb8389ec4.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

The wait is over! The Spooky Event has returned, and so has Monster Girl Cassia. If you’ve been longing to bring this opulence-loving mummy into your main game, you know what to do: complete the Parallel Event before the timer runs out on June 2nd!

Sounds easy, right? Only if you’re brave enough to tackle all the terribly treacherous, bitterly bone-chilling, spectacularly spooky goals this grim Halloween world has to offer! Sure, it’s scary, but we have full faith in you. You brought a flashlight, right?

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: The Lap of Luxury
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/65713205824924612b94fd57a5266bdbcee3e7c2.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps,

Are you looking for a little more sparkle in your life? Well, before you commit to that buy-now-pay-later plan on a diamond-encrusted PC case or whatever, could we interest you in an all-new animated pinup featuring Darya, the sparkliest waifu around, instead? 

All you have to do is complete the Limited Time Event by logging in every day to collect your Daily Tokens, and this mesmerizing vision can be yours! Diamonds are forever, but so is your Memory Album!

And speaking of which… if this pinup has brought a twinkle to your eye, don’t forget to check out Darya’s DLC Bundle in the Store! Not only is she beautiful and brilliant, she also showers you in Diamonds as you get to know her! If we combined her with Bonnibel, we’d have the ultimate Sugar Mama! 

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Ohhhh… sinister synonyms…
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/f329463afa1cc45b40af3c6adcae82919aa29c06.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

Something scary this way comes… It’s almost time for the return of the Spooky Event! Whether you use cuneiform or hieroglyphics, mark your calendars for May 29th to June 2nd, when you’ll have an opportunity to take up horrifying hobbies, work jinxed jobs, and earn some petrifying prizes… including a chance to invite mummy monster girl Cassia into your main game! 

Who says you can’t celebrate Halloween in June?

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Time + Pressure = Diamonds
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/9769a5ac87150f1bc45cf68bed3c80f02dcf8626.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

On your mark, get set, SHOP! It's time to treat yourself, because for 24 hours only, all Diamond Bundles are 15% off. If that doesn’t satiate your need for lovely shiny things, our stunning gemstone-girl, Darya, is a must-have at an unbeatable[b] 50% off[/b]! This is the perfect chance to add some sparkling treasures to your collection, so jump on this offer while you can.

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: You Snooze, You Lose
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/ea48d4deb842ec53ba48b1d27579485f6565fce8.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

On the off chance that you’re asleep right now… stop it! It’s time to wake up! No, don’t hit the snooze button. Tell us, have you ever dreamed of having all your dreams come true? Well, depending on what those dreams are, you might be in luck! And it’s all thanks to this soft and snuggly Elle plush.

Are you awake now? Thought so. She gets our heartbeats going faster, too. She’s just so unbelievably precious! And you wanna know the best part? You don’t even have to share your favorite pillow with this sleepover buddy, because she comes with her own!

All Elle wants is to cuddle in your arms and have the best night’s sleep ever, so if that’s something you want too, then check out our latest Makeship campaign [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/elle-plush]HERE[/url]. Just remember, we have to reach the order threshold before the campaign ends in order to make our Elle plush dream a reality! 

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Avast! Yo-ho! Arr! Etcetera!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/a74965af4a96dcb6de85abb8441598656e522536.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Get out yer spyglasses, me hearties, and look out to yon horizon - there’s a pirate ship approachin’ at speed! The Beach Bash Event has officially kicked off, and Captain Kira is comin’ ashore! If ye be wanting to unlock her in your main game, then ye better heave to and check off all yer Event Goals before the tide goes out and takes her away to sea once more! 

Okay, that’s enough pirate talk for now. The Beach Bash Event runs from May 8th to the 14th, with piles of in-game prizes to be won! And did we mention you get to spend that entire time with your fave waifus in their itty-bitty, teeny-weeny bikinis? Sounds to us like just by showing up, you’ve already won!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Summer Lovin’... Happenin’ faster than you think!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/34cf177979c450dcc2407998929d2bebdf5f593a.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

Got your swimsuit and sunscreen? Summer is upon us (in the Northern Hemisphere, at least!) but get this: it’s coming to Crush Crush EVEN SOONER! No, we haven’t invented time travel… yet. The Beach Bash Event is back! 

From May 8th to the 14th, soak up some sun with a cast of cute bikini babes and complete your event goals to earn in-game prizes and a chance to unlock Kira the pirate! 

Keep your spyglass on the far horizon and remember…

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: Feeling a Solid 15/10!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/a1e3751ac3d4cef1eebedb59571a0c283fd10a3f.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

Ever have one of those days when you wake up and just KNOW things are going to be good? Well, that's how we feel right now, thanks to Golden Week and the sale we're having to celebrate.

From April 29 to May 5, we've got the 15%-off trifecta to offer you! All Diamond Bundles are 15% off and include Alpha's Deluxe Wedding Dress Outfit. We've also got a cool 15% off all DLC Girl Bundles, and 15% off LTE Girls in the Store! That's a lot of discounts. Come on in and pick your pleasure... for less! Here's to a nice day and a great week.

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Hey, Sirina! Add Yourself to the Limited Time Event!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/4b2d5657c4d08c9f27263eb675781cdde07f5e34.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Guess what? The objectively BEST digital assistant is back! If you haven’t had the chance to experience Sirina’s versatile functionality yet, now’s your chance! She’s ready to help you with everything from checking the weather to tracking your location, all while suggesting the perfect playlist for your mood.

Of course, you could also ask her to set a reminder for you to log in every day during the Limited Time Event and collect your daily tokens to unlock all the fantastic features that Sirina brings. Trust us, you won’t regret having her as your virtual assistant!

We love you so hard.

The Pandas

notes.title: Welcome to the Jungle
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/82970f77d3a45cba460bf419c6f5f62b6beb6f55.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Dreaming of a tropical paradise? Save the airfare and escape to somewhere hot, hot, HOT with this all-new animated pinup featuring the world’s fastest waifu, Catara! Think this speedy sweetie might be hard to catch? Don’t worry, humans are persistence hunters! So long as you log in every day of the Limited Time Event and collect all the Daily Tokens, this pinup will be yours!

But before you rush off, we oughta remind you not to sleep on the Catara Bundle, either! It’s the only way for you to experience the electrifying joys of her Speed Dating ability! Talk about giving your game a JOLT. It’s like licking a battery and riding a roller coaster at the same time! 

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Hat Trick
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/aee68ccca9d84b9aa37496ae59d5ee598aabbdf5.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

The Spring Fling Event is here, the Parallel Event Portal is open, and giggling bunny girls are calling! This time around, Pepper is our reward girl, so if you haven’t had the opportunity to add her to your main game yet, here’s your chance!

From April 17th to the 21st, get cracking at various spring-themed jobs and hobbies. Complete event goals and earn hop-tastic rewards for your main game! With your newfound mastery of springtime activities, you will become the true star of the Spring Fling Event!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: A Breath Of Parallel Event Air
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/4c754f01a474cdbd96454091b5586df9ade9e056.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps,

Do you feel that? Something's all wibbly and wobbly. It must mean the Parallel Event Portal is going to open soon! But where will it take you? It doesn’t feel creepy enough to be the Spooky Event. There aren’t enough smells of gingerbread and chocolate for it to be the Frosty Event. No one can hear the crashing of waves, which rules out the Beach Bash Event…

Wait a minute! Did Pepper just pull a set of bunny ears out of her hat? That’s gotta be for the Spring Fling Parallel Event! Bunny girls, colorful eggs, and light pastels are coming your way! Mark your calendars, because you can hop into the flurry of spring activities starting April 17.

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: April Showers
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/9939e844c0601102bccd76d5b028a3f185eb3cbc.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Have you heard? Apparently, April showers bring May flowers! As nice as it sounds, we can’t actually confirm that particular rumor - but we DO know that there’s a special April sale going on right now, and that’s a verifiable fact. Just go check out the in-game Store and you’ll see!

From April 9 to 15, any Diamond Bundle you buy will come with 15% MORE bonus Diamonds. Plus, Peanut’s Deluxe Wedding Outfit will be included as a gift with your purchase! Whatever your weather’s doing this time of year, doesn’t that sound like a nice springtime treat?

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: Flash! A-ah!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/a0e3a0e7dc8e64d5060cd8ef326f07b182cf02ae.png[/img]
It’s a miracle! For a mere 24 hours, we’re throwing a mighty and powerful sale. Brie, our scrumptious space sweetie, is a sensational 50% off! If you’ve already welcomed this vivacious visitor to your game, don’t fret. You can still delight in some Diamond bundles at 15% off.

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: Good news, everyone!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/e0dd66cf145752a153ffd17c7a6ea0c97b587860.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

If you’ve been waiting with bated breath for a chance to leap through that twirly-swirly portal and into a galaxy far, far away, then it’s time for you to let out a biiiig sigh of relief - because the brand new Outer Space Event has officially launched! Your reward girl? A badass space bounty hunter named Loola, who’s literally unlike ANY alien babe you’ve EVER seen. She’s the coolest, toughest intergalactic peacekeeper of all time, and we can’t wait for you to meet her! Hopefully you haven’t been breaking any space-laws?

Remember, you only have from March 27-31 to complete the event and unlock Loola in your Main Game. May the duct tape (you know, that thing that’s light on one side, dark on the other, and holds everything together?) be with you! Commencing countdown, engines on, yadda yadda… Time for blastoff!

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: She Rhymes With Foxy
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/a452b39e352a6f3d5c60e06ee67ac406fb1c6d8a.png[/img]
The time has come for the ravishing Roxxy to return! If you haven’t had a chance to meet our bubbly and bodacious dance babe, you can do it now. Log in daily during the Limited Time Event to collect all the event tokens and unlock our favorite dancing queen. Don’t miss this opportunity to revel in glitter and glow sticks! Her hips don’t lie, and neither will yours. Wink wink!

Best of luck, have fun, and don't lose your rhythm!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Pandas In Space
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/dc6943816016c97a1d782877191fb2fd49cb6c49.png[/img]
Greetings, Panda Peeps!

Space: another frontier. These are the voyages of the starship Uncrushable. Its mission? To explore strange new planets, seek out new smexy waifus, and to boldly (and flirtily) go where no Panda has gone before!

We’re launching a brand new Parallel Event, and in case you haven’t caught on by now, it’s going to be a good old-fashioned sci-fi romp through OUTER SPACE!

You know the drill - this event will feature an array of cosmic jobs and techno hobbies, plus a whole crew of space babes for you to woo! You’ll have from March 27th to 31st (Earth time) to complete it, which includes unlocking a badass new alien love for your Main Game. All we’ll say for now is that she is truly out of this world, and you’ll probably want to surrender, like, immediately.

Now, repeat after us: “Computer, set a reminder for the Outer Space Event on March 27th!”

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: March! March! March! Sale! Sale! Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/cca9ec48e97b7e861a0e7dc7599ee40e59f2ac1c.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

March is here, and so is its madness. What madness, you say? The MEGA SALE kind of madness! 

From March 13 to 18, we have an absolute wheelbarrow full of sales for you to take advantage of! Diamonds, DLC girls, and Phone Fling girls are all 10% off. For this MEGA SALE, we’re also bringing back EVERY SINGLE ONE of the LTE girls at 10% off! This is your chance to stock up on your favorite characters and save big. Otherwise, top up your Diamond stash so you can spoil your favorites with lavish Gifts, Dates, and Outfits!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Six more weeks of winter? Okay!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/d4767ce32753af5bafe8d2213191c5b3c921834c.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

“Snow” of hands: who here likes a blizzard in March? No one? What if we told you that instead of frosty WEATHER it was actually the return of the Frosty EVENT, and it came with another chance to unlock sweet, charming reindeer girl Yuki?

Yeah, that’s more like it! 

Well get those clicking fingers warmed up, because the Frosty Event starts right now, and you only have until March 11th to complete all the goals on your chilly checklist and invite Yuki in from the cold! Spring can wait that long, right?

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: We Heard You Like Snow
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/68f605f212360faea806b1482b8cdb35f0ef78fe.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

The seasons are turning, but don’t you worry. In your game, the snow’s not going anywhere! At least not from March 6 to 11 it’s not. The Parallel Event Portal is opening, and judging by the ice crystals and soft sound of carols coming from it, it must be leading you to Frostmas celebrations!

Mark your calendars and set an alarm because the returning reward girl won’t let snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stay her from the swift completion of her rounds. Work at icy jobs, take up chilly hobbies, and complete all the tasks in time to unlock the cutest reindeer around - Yuki!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Glitter and Gloom for 24 Hours
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/a984083f000228512accc32ed59931c5c711c476.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Get those fingers of yours all warmed up to click “buy” because, for 24 hours, Diamonds are 15% off! For one day only, you can top up on that sweet, sweet premium currency for a discount. If bright and shiny things aren’t enough to grab your attention, we have something else that might tickle your fancy. Curious? Good!

Charlotte, the creepy cutie, is on sale for 50% off! Don’t miss this opportunity to add her to your game. She comes with the exclusive job of Grave Digger, so you can fully embrace the spooky lifestyle and, ultimately, win her black heart.

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Put her service to the test!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/95bd3af66a8aaebe73ecf4b2079221000b186f13.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

Remember when our last Vote-a-Fling ended in an almost-tie, and we promised that your runner-up would get her day in the sun? Well, pull back those curtains and let the light shine in, because today is that day! 

French maid Willow is finally here, and she’s free to unlock for everyone who completes her Limited Time Event! All you have to do is play through her Phone Fling, collect all your Daily Tokens, and she’ll be dusting those cobwebs off your heart in no time! 

She’ll show you the true meaning of service with a smile! (And a wink… and a kiss…)

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: (Whispers) Omelette du fromage…
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/1cef69ac21cefd0415461fe6c1eac346102ab3ff.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

How do you say “Check your texts!” en Francais? We’re just wondering because there are brand new messages from everyone’s fave French maid, Willow, waiting for you now!

And you know what that means…

In a very short time, the Limited Time Event to unlock her will finally be here! 

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Save a Horse, Ride a Cowgirl
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/79ac03d01b82260937535f017c3682dccd5515ba.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

Attention all lovers! The big day is here! No, not Valentine’s Day… or the day after Valentine’s Day when all the chocolate is half-off… It’s the first day of the returning Valentine’s Parallel Event! 

You have from today until February 17th to put on your rose-colored glasses and step through that swirly portal to the Land of Love, where a cast of lovelorn cuties and a cupid’s quiver full of lovey-dovey jobs and hobbies await you! Complete your Event Goals to unlock all the rewards, including the grand prize: Marybelle Valentine in your main game! Yee-haw!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Love Illuminati
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/e51d9d98e5986816740150915de8f8b879ccd730.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Restaurant reservations with your sweetie… $100. Bubble bath for self care… $15. Valentine’s Day drinks… $20. Edible arrangement for mom… $50. Cupid costume for your four-legged friend… $30.

Is it just us, or is Valentine’s Day kinda expensive whether or not you have a date? OMG… Is that why there’s that whole conspiracy about it being a made up holiday by the greeting card companies?! Whoaaaaaa… we just blew our own minds!

Um, anyway, let us give your wallet a break with a Crush Crush Valentine’s Sale! From today until February 18th, take 10% off Diamond Bundle purchases and get Nutaku-chan’s Unique Outfit as a bonus! We’d make a joke about what kind of date Nutaku-chan is, but that would spoil the fun of finding out for yourself! 

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Lasso Yourself Some Love
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/59b7e86ba298e1b6062d5f3bcbf111d046db46a6.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Shoot, is it almost Valentine’s Day already? Well you know what that means… time for the return of our Valentine’s Parallel Event, and with it, one more precious chance for you to unlock a very special Valentine… Marybelle Valentine, that is!

So don’t forget to draw some pink hearts on your calendar for the dates of February 13th through the 17th, because if you stand these gals up, it might be a while before the opportunity to woo them comes around again!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: We Gonna Party Like It’s Our Birthday!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/e5a478aa771fdcf5c984b6cfcbe3cecaada53cac.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

In honor of Crush Crush’s 9th anniversary, we’re releasing a brand new, exclusive pinup! Peanut, Nova, and Wendy are all in a partying mood and looking to celebrate the day with you.

All you have to do is log in any time between now and Feb 12, and this beautiful artwork will be added to your Memory Album! No Daily Tokens, no Limited Time Event, no Diamonds, nothing. Then, it’s yours, and you can enjoy it forever. So mark your calendars and set your alarms, because you don’t want to miss this opportunity to get your hands on this party pinup!

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: Short and sweet, like this month!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/68745c374722ac089ea078f2c7aa87662a998527.png[/img]

It features a cast of animal-themed girls and a story that includes Catara - and yes, she’ll be bringing her handy Speed Dating mechanic with her. Plus, your “reward girl” this time is actually a reward duo! That’s right - completing the event will unlock TWO new girls for your Main Game. They’re basically a bonded pair, so of course they’re a package deal!

Now, this event is going to be pretty unique compared to all the others, so listen up! You’ve got from January 27 - 30 to check off all your cute, cozy goals and unlock your brand new girl duo, and then that’s it. This event will never run again… sort of. It’s actually going to be added to the in-game Store instead, so if you don’t manage to complete it the first time, you’ll have the option to purchase and play it again - whenever you want, with zero pressure!

The purpose of this is to set up the Fuzzy Event as our official “newcomer event”. So going forward, it will automatically run for brand new players as an introduction to the whole parallel event system - just once, for everyone. After that, it will be available in each player’s Store if they didn't complete it! That means every single person, no matter if they started playing years ago or won’t start playing for another six months, gets ONE free shot at completing the Fuzzy Event, followed by an option to purchase it (it'll get added to the store at a future date).

Okay, that’s enough blathering for now! We hope you’re pumped for the Fuzzy Event and the wonderful character duo that comes with it - if you are, don’t forget to mark those calendars!

That being said… WOW, was it ever a close race! We’ve been on the edges of our seats all week, watching as Honey took first place, then Willow took first place, then Honey took first place, then Willow… you get the idea. In the end, Honey just barely took the lead - which is why we’ve decided to give her the fully-dateable makeover first, and then transform Willow next!

First thing’s first, though: Honey’s grown up a bit since the surreal television-themed days of her youth. Now that she’s done with the stay-at-home-mom phase of her life, she needs someone to remind her how to be weird, have fun, and put her own needs first! Who better than YOU to show her the way?

Behind the scenes, we’re already working hard to transform Honey from “how do I use this smartphone thing anyway?” to “we can hold hands now!” and beyond. We seriously can’t wait to introduce her as a fully-dateable character, followed by Willow afterwards. Thank you SO much for making this such an exciting Vote-a-Fling!

We love you so hard,

Love you all so hard,

notes.title: Happy Anniversary, Crush Crush!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/c9bb35ea9938b0c6b67e5f84e7a0c75a61d5e909.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

Did you know that the traditional five-year anniversary gift is wood? And the "modern" version... Is silverware!

Yeah, neither of those options seemed very "Crush Crush" to us.... Or fun at all… So we decided to go with something else.

To celebrate a whole half-decade of Crush Crush existing, we're giving away a beautiful commemorative pinup to every player who logs in between Feb 8th and Feb 15th. Once you log in, this brand new artwork will be added to your Memory Album for keepsies <3 

This is just our way of saying "thank you for being a fan." We hope you know how truly grateful we are for all your support…. And that's as sappy as we're going to get, because we prefer to avoid openly weeping at the office. So just take your pinup and enjoy it!

And remember, we love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: Sawyer Up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/ae4e340d44cc894702fa0cf3bd2bf06a5f02df40.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Congratulations to Sawyer on doing the thing with the points and winning the Crush Crush Vote-a-Fling!

She really smashed the competition this time, and we're super stoked about her promotion. In fact, we're donning our sneakers and volleyball short-shorts as we speak! (It's kind of like a method acting thing, but for transforming Phone Fling girls into fully-dateable characters.)

As for the other gals, everyone played their best and gave it 110%. At the end of the day, you just gotta take it one game at a time. Play to win, but remember it's a marathon, not a sprint. Keep your eye on the ball and don't throw in the towel. A win is just a win, but you never know when your waifu will hit it right out of the park. Yay sportsball!

Anyway, we're gonna get the ball rolling on Sawyer, so keep an eye out for updates, including when she'll be ready to get her head in the game! And thank you so much to everyone who participated in this event.

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

Hey Panda Peeps!

It's Vote-a-Fling time!

So which Phone Fling gal will win this round and become the next fully-dateable character? You decide! 

For one week only, completed Phone Fling conversations will feature a fancy "Vote" button at the bottom of the chat. You get 1 free vote automatically, with the option of purchasing up to 4 extras! Spread your votes around if you like, or pile them all onto your absolute favorite. The girl who gets the most votes wins!

(Obviously, you won’t be able to vote for girls who’ve have already been promoted, because… they’ve… already been promoted. #unnecessarydisclaimer)

There’s tons of girls to choose from, so who’s it going to be? This Vote-a-Fling runs from November 23rd to November 30th, and we'll be announcing the eagerly-awaited results on December 1st!

Love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: A Gentle Hello
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/1402d8be4a2fe98bbf08bf604f711321d1790db6.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps. 

We’re keeping our voices down, because we have a very fun but very shy DLC update for you today. A special new girl with a little twist - we hope you like her. 

Suzu is here. She’s a shy forest spirit - a Kitsune (fox spirit) that brings good luck and joy wherever she goes. The only downside is… She’s shy. Which is not the best trait to have when you’re also maybe sort-of a guardian of various natural and spiritual places of harmony. 

Suzu’s DLC bundle comes with a few extra goodies, including her outfits and a new Tree Planting Job - which is both a great way to earn a living and do some good in the world of Crush Crush. And the Job scales especially well for end-game players, so we think you’ll like it. And something we're experimenting with - an animated pose! Once you get her to Lover, all her outfits should unlock including an animated version of her main pose.

So check out Suzu, and consider unlocking her. Her DLC is $4 USD, and we’ve put in extra love and care into her that we think you’ll enjoy. 

As Suzu would say - Arigatou Gozaimasu! (Though then she would ‘eep!’ and hide.) Let us know what you think! 

You're awesome!
--
The Pandas

Hey Panda Peeps,

So, we’ve got a nifty surprise for you today, and also a big quality of life improvement too. 

First the nifty surprise - a new Phone CALL! Not a Phone Fling, a Phone Call. It’s different.

How is it different? Well, Phone Calls include vocal performances by one of our lovely Voice Actresses, and they’re all kinds of shiver-inducing fun! 

So far we’ve only done one, for Renée, and we got lots of positive feedback for it. So now it’s time for round two. This time, you’ll be getting a call from everyone’s favorite angsty sk8r grrl, Nova. She’s in a bit of a jam and could use a friend. So definitely don’t ghost her.

To unlock it, you’ll need to finish Nova’s first Phone Fling, and then make sure your own Angst skill is at level 40. Get on that - and enjoy your chat with Nova. 
~~~~~~
In other news, we’ve got a big improvement that LOTS of people have been asking for - improved LTE Token discounts! 

What does that mean? Well, you know how the Limited Time Event rewards can be purchased for less diamonds the more Tokens you collect? Well, lots of people were asking (very politely, mind you, not a single pitchfork in sight) that after the event is over, they should still be able to buy the reward unlock for the discount they had earned.  Basically, the option should remember how many Tokens you collected.

Well it does that now! If you earn a bunch of Tokens during an event, you’ll be able to buy the character/pinup/outfits (for a limited time) for the discounted price you earned in the LTE popup. 

Thanks for your patience for this feature - we’ve been hard at work on a ton of content, and since we wrapped up a few big technical things elsewhere, we were able to jump on this quality of life improvement.

We really hope you enjoy it and your call, and make sure to let us know what you think! 

Love you all so hard!

notes.title: Phone Flings Voting!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24136664/b7c707bcf4fb0f224a5124a36e1ec3b2e2bb0f85.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Polish up that voting finger and get ready to democracy, because it’s time for another Phone Fling Voting poll! 

In case this is your first time democracy-ing, here’s what’s going on: every so often, we do a poll to see which gal the community would like to see upgraded to full character / date-able status. It’s easy! Once you finish a Phone Fling conversation, you'll be given the option to vote for that girl to be promoted.

Everyone gets 1 free vote. And, if you're really serious, you can buy a few extra votes with diamonds. (Up to 4 extra votes, just as a way to show your enthusiasm for your favorite waifus.)

If you choose to get the extra votes, you can spread them around to all your favorite ladies. Or just make them rain on one girl in particular. It's your call!

Last time we did a poll, we got a TON of suggestions from the community on ways to make it better. Players were worried that waifus that are new or more difficult to unlock had the odds stacked against them. While others really didn’t like you could see the running total of votes, because it created weird popularity contests and divided waifu-lovers everywhere.

So we’re definitely tweaking how things are done, but we’re going to tweak things one at a time. This time the vote tally won’t be revealed until the end of the poll. It’s a secret to everyone, so anticipation will be high. We’re considering a few other major and minor tweaks as well, but we’ll be introducing them in subsequent polls.  

So get out there, earn some diamonds, vote for your waifus and wait to see if the Phone Fling of your dreams makes to the big leagues. And by “big leagues”, I mean into your digital embrace. (Aww.)

Here's how it works - Once you finish a Phone Fling conversation, you'll be given the option to vote for that girl to be promoted.

Everyone gets 1 free vote. And, if you're really serious, you can buy a few extra votes with diamonds. (Up to 4 extra votes, just as a way to show your enthusiasm for your favorite waifus.)

Vote your heart, show your love, and cross your fingers. Let us know your thoughts, and best of luck! Love you all so hard!

notes.title: Head's Up! Scavenger Hunt
notes.notes:
It’s time for a little holiday hijinks! We’ve got a scavenger hunt for you that’ll have you looking everywhere for balls - snowballs of course!

Every day, a sneaky snowball will be hidden somewhere in the game. And you only have 24 hours to find it. 

If you miss a snowball, you can trade 5 diamonds for it - no questions asked. Or, if you’re the baller-type, you can just buy all of the snowballs at once because who are we to stop you!

notes.title: Pamu Needs Your Help!
notes.notes:
Hey Panda Peeps!  
We’ve got something random and (we hope) kind of cool to ask you guys about today. Specifically about a Kickstarter that might get a dash of Panda with some support. Here’s the dealio:   

Love Esquire is a Dating Sim / RPG / Visual Novel that looks like it could have come right out of a Panda Playbook. It’s shiny and sexy, and the game even features our very own and wonderful Melody Muze, who voiced Elle and human-form Bearverly in Crush Crush!  

They just launched a Kickstarter, so we sent them our well wishes and support. Which led to the kind and lovely people over at Yangyang reaching back to us to chat.  

To cut to the chase - we mentioned that it might be cool to have a Crush Crush girl cameo in Love Esquire, and the Yangyang folks were all over that idea. So they gave us this link: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yangyangmobile/love-esquire?ref=6mefdw] HERE [/url] said if our Panda Peeps come through with $3,000 of support *through that link*, they’d add a Crush Crush cameo to Love Esquire.  

Now we want to be super clear: Sad Panda isn’t making Love Esquire. We can’t speak to what the final product will be, or how large the Crush Crush cameo would be. But if this goal is hit, we’ll definitely work closely with Yangyang to ensure Pamu is pure and highly concentrated. Ready to spit fire and inappropriate meta jokes in someone else’s game.  

So check out the Love Esquire Kickstarter, search your feelings, and throw some support their way if the moment takes you!  

Lots of love, The Pandas  

P.S. A short follow-up message from Pamu herself: “Listen up Kick-Dickers, or whatever you’re called! This is win / win! You get to spend money on me, and *I* get to mack on the Love Esquire biatches. So don’t be such a Pamu! Just throw your wallet at the screen, lie back and think of England. Oh! And don’t forget to leave a “Moist” comment in the Love Esquire comment section! #PamuSellsOutAgain!”

notes.title: Here To Make You Diamonds
notes.notes:
Hey Panda Peeps! We’ve got a very special addition today that we’re excited to announce - a new DLC character!

Her name is Darya, and she’s sort of like a huge diamond bonus with a pretty smile! 

Here’s how she works: her character is “Diamond” themed. That means whenever you complete her levels, she rewards a TON of diamonds. WAY more than the other girls. 

Some of her requirements involve gilding jobs and hobbies, but her level up rewards are worth much more diamonds than she what costs. So by the time you’re finished you’ll have a fully gilded game with a few hundred extra diamonds left over. Basically you spend $15 USD, and get over $40 worth of diamonds and new content. By Grabthar’s Hammer! What a Savings!

For those not interested, Darya's achievements are only added to the game if you purchase the DLC, so no worries if you don't decide to pick it up. You won’t suddenly have a hole in your achievements list. 

Darya is fully voiced, comes with all her outfits and brings you lots of extra diamonds!

If Darya is a success, (fingers crossed!) we’ll be in a much better position to consider other content or characters and platforms moving forward. 

Thanks for everything. We hope you consider supporting Crush Crush with her DLC, and we really hope you like minerals!
~Sad Panda

notes.title: V.0.235 Kickstarter Announcement (and LTE update)
notes.notes:
Panda has been busy at work launching our new game Kitty Catsanova (currently beta testing on Kongregate but will be on Steam soon) and preparing a new girl in Crush Crush, as well as other cool stuff we aren’t ready to share just yet ;)

First thing - we’re really excited to announce that starting tomorrow (May 1) we will be launching a Kickstarter for a new dating game! It will feature several of our Crush Crush girls in a new setting / storyline. 

It’s not so much a sequel as it’s a re-imagining. This visual novel will play a lot like Long Live the Queen, and explore darker and more mature themes - which we’re stoked about - while keeping up the same comedy/flirty tone you’d find in Crush Crush.

Onto Crush Crush! In today’s update we’ve made some changes to the LTE (limited time events) system (which frankly are a bit overdue). Back when Crush Crush was our only focus, these would have reached you guys much sooner, so we’re super sorry we tested your patience with them! 

Here is a quick run-down on the latest changes:
[list]
[*] Event tokens now don’t have timers! They’re instantly rewarded (but you still have to click ‘Claim!’).
[*] Players will now have to earn every token for an event, but the cost for those tokens has gone down as well. A missed token won’t have as much of a heavy penalty.
[*] One of the Daily Tasks will always be a Diamond Reward (or sometimes a Time Block reward), but we will be increasing the time they take and Time Block consumption. Now players have access to a daily diamond grinder. This difficulty increase is partially to offset the much easier LTE rewards. (Let us know how these changes feel!)  
[*] Diamond costs for insta-finishing Tasks has been substantially lowered as well.
[*] The next few rewards are for bikinis and then we’ll be bringing back last year’s “Summer Fling” Pin-up.
[/list]

Hopefully that helps address some of the issues people had with the LTE. We’d love to hear what you think, and will do our best to read all of the Steam comments and Forum threads. It’s just a crazy busy time for us right now so we can’t guarantee we’ll be able to respond to many of them v.v

Thanks everyone!
~Sad Pandas

Update: The kickstarter is LIVE here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sadpandastudios/hush-hush-only-your-love-can-save-them

[/list]
Let us know if you find any issues with this build and how you like the voices ^_^  We're so proud of all the actresses who voiced our girls, and we love every performance so much!! We hope you like them too <3

~Artist Panda

We’re pretty stoked to announce that we’ve added a feature to Crush Crush that’s been in the works for some time: more languages!

Check the credits for the names of our lovely translators. And we hope you enjoy having Pamu say inappropriate things to you in whatever language you like best.
Peace!
--
The Sad Panda Team

notes.title: V.0.215 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I hope you are all having an awesome month, and hopefully everyone is gearing up for a good 2018.  We had a very busy end of December, and this release is the culmination of a lot of that work.

New Features:
- Support for the limited time event system going forward into 2018.

Bug Fixes:
- Lots of translation fixes (with localization enabled on the beta branch - check it out!).
- Fixing up several null reference exceptions and other possible errors.
- Try to be better about ensuring that previously completed events aren't wiped out by accident.
- Much better logging of internal faults and errors.
- Cleaned up a lot of the code that connects to our backend server for improved stability.

Happy New Years!

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Nutaku-versary
notes.notes:
It’s ON!

October is here, and so is our 1 year Nutaku Anniversary Event! Happy birthday Nutaku Chan!

notes.title: Heads UP! New stuff is coming!
notes.notes:
Hey Panda Pals, we’ve got some stuff ready to launch which is going to change the game. Hopefully in a really good way!

We’re introducing a new rewards system. Its technical name is a “Limited Time Event” system, but you can call it, “Click stuff / get stuff” or whatever feels cuddly to you. 

This system will allow you to assign Time Blocks, run some progress bars, and come back later to claim some cool rewards. Simple! 

The sorts of rewards you can expect to see are everything from small cash boosts to Diamond rewards (say whaaaaat???!?). New rewards will appear every 24 hours, so it’s basically a way to reward peeps for logging in a bunch. The trick is you’ll have to come back to claim stuff. Hee hee! Sneaky game devs!

Included in this system are going to be “Event” rewards - stuff like outfits, pinups, and some future surprises that should rock your socks off. For these bigger rewards, you’ll have to log in over multiple days. You can even miss a few days, but only so many before you’ll have to spend some Diamonds to catch up. Or just spend some Diamonds to get the rewards instantly if you don’t mind dropping some bank on us. 

This new system is part of our efforts to introduce more places to spend Diamonds, AND giving us a way to introduce some more Diamond rewards for active players. We hope you like it, and we hope you’ll send us feedback on the kinds of stuff you want to see as rewards once we launch it. 

So don’t miss the launch of this nifty new system! We're aiming to premiere it on October 5, to celebrate our 1 year anniversary of being on the NSFW website Nutaku (and the addition of our naughty nympho, Nutaku Chan!). So the first reward you’ll be working toward is an Exclusive outfit for Nutaku. Don’t disappoint her (she has whips and handcuffs!)

The reward after that is an exclusive pin up, featuring Nutaku and Pamu. Definitely one you might consider the Panda Pass for. The SFW and NSFW versions are pretty different.

Love you so hard!
--The Pandas

notes.title: V.0.166 NSFW dlc is out!
notes.notes:
Greetings sugar cookies, OjiPanda here. 

Let’s chat about the Nude DLC. 

Wowzers this took a while, hey? Today I’m here to chat about what the Nude DLC is, how it works, why it works the way it do, and what the future holds for Crush Crush, Sad Panda, and the fate of the universe. Here’s what’s going down:

Sad Panda is going to start offering paid Nude DLC expansions to our games. We’re going to be offering this DLC on our own website: [url=https://sadpandastudios.com] HERE [/url]

I imagine you have some questions, and here’s what I imagine they sound like:

[h1] [Why are you doing this on your own website?] [/h1]

For the last… bunch of months, we’ve been chatting with a few platforms on guidelines for adult content. Unfortunately, this has been a frustrating process. Some platforms don’t want to set guidelines, and others are simply against the inclusion of such content. There’s a very strong “try and see” mentality in the industry, which has unfortunately cost some developers dearly when the hammer does fall.

So we decided that, if we’re going to be able to offer our fans what they want regardless of platform, we would need a platform-agnostic solution. So we got to work on a system that, once the DLC is purchased, adds the NSFW content as an ‘Uncensored Mode’ toggle in-game. 

[h1] [Why does the DLC cost money, you greedy sons of bitches?] [/h1]

There are a few reasons. But I know that whenever game developers ask for money, (especially in F2P games) it can cause a lot of mixed feelings. I get it. I’m right there with you. Game devs can sometimes get shady or grabby with this kind of stuff, so I’mma try to keep it above board with you guys.

The first is - we want to have a purchase between the DLC and the user so we can have some control over who has it. In effect, we want to have an age restriction step to authenticating it. Why? It’s all about due diligence and image. We don’t want to make the DLC easily available to kids. We’re all about creating sexy adult content for adults. 

Now, as the nude version of the game will remain available on Nutaku for free, this may seem a bit suspect. We are leaning on Nutaku’s own age gating for their site, which is not as difficult to overcome as providing a credit card transaction, but we’re okay with this arrangement. Again - due dilligence and image. 

The next reason is - we feel that the sexy content is worth paying for. We’ve priced the DLC a bit higher than an average purchase in Crush Crush ($7), and have included a bunch of stuff to make it a worthwhile purchase ($5 of diamonds and all the “sexy” outfits for free). 

One huge advantage to the Steam version is we can offer high-res sexy artwork. It’ll be the shiniest version available for sure. Future voiced audio will also have the ‘nsfw’ bonus audio included in this mode. Audio files can be pretty large for a web game so we’re only going to be adding this feature to the Steam version.

[h1] [I checked out the site. What’s the “Panda Pass” option?] [/h1]

Going forward, we’re going to be launching more games in the Crush Crush universe, and offering similar adult DLC for each one. 

The Panda Pass DLC is an option to unlock all the future NSFW DLC, for all Sad Panda games. 

It might go up in price over time. Who knows? BEST DEAL! BUY TODAY!

[h1] [Can I trust this transaction? You’re not using some dodgy credit card software, are you?] [/h1]

We’re actually using some code / backend support from none other than the Humble Bundle guys. They have a great system that anyone can jump on, so we decided to run with that. 

[h1] [So what do I gotta do? And what do I get?] [/h1]

The NSFW DLC adds a ‘Uncensored Mode’ toggle to Crush Crush on Steam. It adds hi-res sexy scenes and pinups, and includes free "lingerie" and "birthday suit" outfits and 55 diamonds.

Here’s how you get it! [url=https://www.sadpandastudios.com/nsfw_faq.html]
 FAQ [/url]

[h1] [Are you guys going to keep updating Crush Crush? You’ve talked about other features in the past…] [/h1]

We are. We’ve had our hands full the last half year, but we’ve got some cool stuff we still want to add. At some point, we’re going to work on a VN and spin-offs, because we’ve stretched the Crush Crush experience to its limit, but we definitely have a backlog of features we’d like to see added before we consider Crush Crush complete. 

Okay, I think that covers everything. If you have questions (or if you want to bitch out OjiPanda, because he’s a filthy sellout) then please post below. 

Love you guys, more soon. 
[b] ------------------------------ [/b]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
   [*] If you haven't noticed the new icon in the top right, we've added in a notifications area where you can read information about the latest news from Sad Panda Studios!  This includes patch notes, announcements on new events, and is a place where we can let you know about things we are working on.  It's pretty basic for now, but we're going to evolve it to include other content (such as images, etc) in the future!
   [*] Your memory album should now persist across prestige.  This means you can still check out all of the images you earned from your previous games.
   [*] Automatic cloud save to help with recovering lost save files (due to a reformat, etc).
   [*]  Reduced the size of the installed game by about 16MB (almost 10%).
   [*] A little sound byte plays when the game first starts, which was a request from Artist Panda.
   [*] A checkbox now appears on completed hobbies (hobbies that have hit level 75).  We also moved the play/pause/checkbox icon a little bit to show up in the middle of the progress bar.
   [*] The progress text on hobbies now disappears when the hobby hits maximum level.
 [*] The new website is now live, and includes integration for the Humble Widget for purchasing the NSFW DLC.  We just did some test purchases, and it works well so far.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Masked UI elements that should be off-screen at non-standard resolutions.
   [*] Fixed sorting for some popups so that they appear over particles.
   [*] Better error handling when loading the game (as well as pushing exceptions to us so that we can help debug the issues that some people are seeing).
[/list]

notes.title: V.0.111
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've been hard at work on this update because it's pretty unique. There's a bunch of cool stuff we did differently this time, so here are the update notes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] TWO new girls added, with crazy different requirements.
    [*] Final cutscenes.
    [*] Music changes (for dramatic impact!)
    [*] End Credits
    [*] Updated the Stats page to have icons represented with the stats (easier to identify requirements this way)

    [*] New settings to skip girl introductions and affection popups (check the Settings dialog on the More page)
    [*] New achievements for the different Outro choices and for reset boosts
    [*] DXT5 image compression butchers some of the art, so we're moving some of that back to Truecolor (32-bit).  This will increase game size a bit, but will make the art much nicer in some cases.

[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed achievement icon issues.
    [*] Fixed typos.
    [*] Improved asset bundles and loading intros.
    [*] Added in some text that was missing.

    [*] Re-wrote the way in which hobby progression is computed, which will fix many issues people had with online progress calculation.  You should now find the hobby progress will work correctly even when your reset boost/purchased boost are low, and even when online.
    [*] Fixed a couple of places that null reference exceptions could occur.
    [*] Reset the number of assets that need to be loaded/have loaded so that you don't get ever increasing numbers on the loading screen.
    [*] Resized a couple of images to take better advantage of image compression.

Also, in other fun news we finalized our cast for the lovely ladies who will be voicing our characters. Recording is already underway; so we'll be posting info on our cast next week (@crushcrushDX).

Then we're off to GDC to soak up lots of knowledge, meet other developers, and try to hunt down a publisher for getting Crush Crush on mobile! Wish us good luck.

~Sad Pandas

    [*] Improved asset bundles and loading intros.
    [*] Added in some text that was missing.

    [*] Re-wrote the way in which hobby progression is computed, which will fix many issues people had with online progress calculation.  You should now find the hobby progress will work correctly even when your reset boost/purchased boost are low, and even when online.
    [*] Fixed a couple of places that null reference exceptions could occur.
    [*] Reset the number of assets that need to be loaded/have loaded so that you don't get ever increasing numbers on the loading screen.
    [*] Resized a couple of images to take better advantage of image compression.
